conditions.label: Has employees
conditions.description: Pays wages or salaries and runs a payroll.

conditions.label: Registered for VAT
conditions.description: Registered for value added tax or a similar turnover tax.

profileFields.label: Company name
profileFields.description: The registered name, including the LLC legal form. The standard form for a small or medium business.

profileFields.label: Commercial registration number
profileFields.description: The number the company register gave the company.

profileFields.label: Registered office address
profileFields.description: The address on the company register.

profileFields.label: Share capital
profileFields.description: The capital the company was registered with. Leave it empty if the form has no share capital.

roles.label: Director
roles.description: Runs the company and represents it.

roles.label: Shareholder
roles.description: Owns shares or a stake in the company.

setupSteps.title: Choose and check the LLC name
setupSteps.description: Check the name is free in Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion and follows Oman's naming rules.
setupSteps.authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion

setupSteps.title: Prepare the LLC documents
setupSteps.description: Prepare the articles or statutes, the founders' details and the registered office. The registration process sets out what it needs.
setupSteps.authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion

setupSteps.title: Register the LLC
setupSteps.description: Submit the incorporation documents as Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion requires. The company exists once the register enters it.
setupSteps.authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion

setupSteps.title: Register the LLC for tax
setupSteps.description: Register with Tax Authority for the company's tax number and any VAT or payroll accounts it needs.

setupSteps.title: Register as an employer
setupSteps.description: Before the first hire, register with Social Protection Fund for payroll and social contributions.

setupSteps.title: Open a business bank account
setupSteps.description: Banks usually ask for the registration certificate and the tax number.

setupSteps.title: Check licences for your activity
setupSteps.description: Some activities need a permit or a licence from a sector regulator. Check before you start trading.

obligations.title: Annual return or confirmation statement
obligations.description: Check whether an annual return or confirmation statement is due with Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, then file it and keep the company record current.
obligations.authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion

obligations.title: Annual financial statements
obligations.description: Prepare the annual accounts. Check whether they must be filed with Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, the deadline and whether an audit is required.
obligations.authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion

obligations.title: Corporate income tax return
obligations.description: Check the company's income tax filing with Tax Authority, then file the return and pay by the dates it sets.

obligations.title: VAT returns
obligations.description: File VAT returns with Tax Authority and pay any VAT due. Check whether the company is registered and how often it files.

obligations.title: Payroll taxes and social contributions
obligations.description: Withhold and remit payroll taxes and social contributions for employees through Social Protection Fund. Check the rates and dates.

obligations.title: Beneficial ownership information
obligations.description: Check whether the country requires a beneficial ownership filing. If it does, keep the record up to date and file it with Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion.
obligations.authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion

obligations.title: Report changes to the register
obligations.description: Check what changes must be reported to Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, then tell it about changes to the name, address, directors or share capital within its deadline.
obligations.authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion

obligations.title: Renew licences and permits
obligations.description: Check which licences your activity needs and renew them before they expire.
